default.title: Production consolidation and commerce migration
default.summary: Consolidate selected commerce workspaces into the production environment with guarded data transfer, bounded order history, storage controls, and separately verified provider reconnection. Local development remains isolated behind authenticated access.
features: Selected commerce workspaces can be transferred into an existing production organization without replacing production-owned data
Each sales channel and shipping provider is reviewed and reconnected independently before it can run in production
Order-history coverage is selected per sales channel so operators can retain relevant history without loading an unlimited backlog
Commerce storage maintenance keeps current order evidence while retiring superseded payloads and bounding retained snapshots
Authenticated local development can use the development hostname without exposing its database or application listeners directly
fixes: Migration plans bind exact source and target identities, row counts, checksums and immutable receipts before any apply step
Production provider credentials are never copied from another organization; target credentials require fresh, account-bound authorization
Provider reconnection rejects concurrent configuration, capability, history-policy or store-sync changes
Database health accepts only the verified rolling migration phases and rejects changed migration bytes or unsafe function configuration
Provider and migration safety suites now run as part of the standard release test gate
